meta.story: A firm placing capital across precious metals, proprietary algorithmic strategies, digital assets, and select alternatives, for a small number of private clients since 2023.

hero.lead: A gold-led programme, algorithmically informed, offered by introduction to a small book of private clients.

folio.label: Fund at a glance
folio.title: KJC Growth Fund
folio.body: Four registers, one discipline, and a book bounded at twenty investors and USD twenty million. The ceiling is the point.

home.registersLead: The book is led by metal. Everything else earns its place against it.

registers.name: Precious metals
registers.body: Gold first, and silver where it earns the room. This is the centre of gravity of the book rather than a hedge bolted on at the edge of it.

registers.name: Algorithmic strategies
registers.body: Systematic models, executed to written rules and without discretion at the point of execution. The mechanics are the firm's own and are not disclosed.

registers.name: Digital assets
registers.body: A capped allocation to the largest and most liquid digital assets. Sized to be survivable in every case, and decisive in none.

registers.name: Select alternatives
registers.body: Positions taken outside the listed markets, one at a time, and only where the firm can see the whole of what it is buying.

home.leadIntro: KJC Capital places capital across four registers for a small number of private clients.
home.leadBody: Our approach is deliberate. Four registers, one discipline, and a bounded number of investors who receive a monthly statement and, otherwise, considered silence.

principles.title: Discipline over prediction.
principles.body: The programme is executed to written rules. It is not a view on the direction of any single market, nor a story about macroeconomic conditions. It is a process, applied consistently, day after day.

principles.title: A small book, by choice.
principles.body: The fund is capped at twenty investors and USD twenty million in assets. The purpose of the ceiling is fidelity: to run the same programme in the same way, without the drift that attends scale.

principles.title: Considered silence.
principles.body: Investors receive a monthly statement and are otherwise not asked to attend to their capital. The absence of noise is intentional; it is one of the reasons the programme works.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.title: One rhythm, held to.
cadence.lead: The month is the unit of measurement. Everything else is left to the programme.

steps.title: Net asset value is struck.
steps.body: On the first business day of each month, NAV is calculated to a written procedure and recorded immutably. Subscriptions received in the preceding month are settled at this strike.

steps.title: The statement is issued.
steps.body: Each investor receives one page: opening balance, contributions, distributions, and closing balance. No commentary, no chart, no exposure detail.

steps.title: The programme runs.
steps.body: Between strikes there is nothing to attend to. The programme executes to rules. Investors are not asked to hold a view.

steps.title: Notice window opens.
steps.body: Redemption is settled at the strike following a thirty-day notice period, on the same page as subscription. There is no gate.

home.outroBody: The programme is offered by introduction. If it appears to fit, write to us, and a director will reply personally. Replies are ordinarily within two business days.
home.outroSignoff: The firm is not registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and does not accept U.S. persons.

firm.metaDescription: KJC Capital is a private investment firm registered in the British Virgin Islands, running a single programme for a small book of private clients since 2023.
firm.leadIntro: KJC Capital is a private investment firm based in the British Virgin Islands. The firm was established in 2023 and runs a single programme on behalf of a small book of private clients.

sections.label: History
sections.body: The firm's founding was unassuming. A quantitative approach that had been refined over several years, run first on personal capital and subsequently on the accounts of family and close acquaintances, was formalised into a fund in 2023. The purpose of the formalisation was not growth. It was to draw a clear line between the firm's capital and its clients', to establish the reporting cadence that its clients had come to expect informally, and to bring the arrangement within a recognisable regulatory shape.

sections.label: People
sections.body: The firm is small on purpose. Its principals hold the majority of the fund's capital themselves. That is the first fact worth stating; the alignment of interest between the manager and the client is not an aspiration but a structural feature.

sections.label: Domicile
sections.body: The fund is registered in the British Virgin Islands as an Incubator Fund under the Securities and Investment Business (Incubator and Approved Funds) Regulations 2015. The Incubator regime is a light-touch category designed for the early period of a fund's life. It caps investor count at twenty, assets at USD twenty million, and requires graduation to a heavier category within two years. The firm views this ceiling as a discipline, not a limit.

programme.metaDescription: A gold-led programme across four registers: precious metals, proprietary algorithmic strategies, a bounded digital-asset allocation, and select alternatives.
programme.leadIntro: The KJC Growth Fund runs a single, rules-based programme across four registers. What follows is a description of the shape of the engagement; the mechanics of the strategy itself are the firm's proprietary matter and are not disclosed.

sections.label: What it is
sections.body: A discretionary programme, run to written rules and executed algorithmically. The book is led by precious metals and extends into proprietary systematic strategies, a bounded allocation to the most liquid digital assets, and select alternatives taken by exception. Every position is sized against a fixed risk budget.

sections.label: What an investor sees
sections.body: One number. The investor's balance, valued at the most recent monthly NAV strike. There is no view of the underlying positions, no live profit and loss feed, no strategy commentary. This is deliberate. The programme's edge is in its consistency of execution, and a running commentary on daily fluctuations would ask investors to attend to the wrong thing.

sections.label: What it does not do
sections.body: The programme does not offer capital guarantees, targeted returns, or a fixed distribution. It does not lend the fund's assets, and it does not take a position the firm could not exit in ordinary market conditions. It does not accept US persons as investors.

governance.metaDescription: Fund structure, the monthly NAV strike, valuation across registers, fees and the audit record for the KJC Growth Fund, a BVI Incubator Fund.
governance.leadIntro: The firm operates within a framework that is intentionally boring. What matters at the size of this fund is not the number of controls but that the ones in place are followed, every time.

sections.label: Fund structure
sections.body: The BVI Incubator Fund holds all investor capital in a segregated account. Investor money is never commingled with the firm's operating capital. Subscriptions are settled at the following month's NAV strike; redemptions are settled at the NAV strike following a thirty-day notice period.

sections.label: Net Asset Value
sections.body: NAV is struck on the first business day of each month. The calculation is performed in-house, with a written procedure applied identically each month, and every strike is recorded immutably. Because the Incubator regime does not require an external administrator, the discipline of the procedure carries the weight that an administrator would otherwise carry.

sections.label: Valuation across registers
sections.body: Each register is valued on a stated basis and the basis does not move between strikes. Precious metals are struck against an established afternoon benchmark price; digital assets against the volume-weighted price at the strike on the venues the fund actually trades; alternatives at cost until an event supports a different figure. Where a register cannot be valued cleanly, it is held at the more conservative of the available figures and the reason is written into the record.

sections.label: Fees
sections.body: The firm charges a management fee of two per cent per annum, accrued daily and charged against the fund on a quarterly basis. A performance fee of twenty per cent is applied against each investor's individual high-water mark, at each quarterly reset, so that no investor is charged a performance fee on ground previously covered.

sections.label: Reporting and records
sections.body: Every action taken by the firm on the fund's book is logged, timestamped, and retained. The audit record is available on request to any investor, and to counsel for any investor, at any time.

footer.notice: KJC Capital and the KJC Growth Fund are offered only by introduction and only to persons the firm has satisfied itself are eligible under the Incubator Fund regime. Nothing on this site constitutes an offer to the public.
